new_counterexample.name: verification_reservation_and_consumption_receipts_cross_alias_into_operation_roles
new_counterexample.precondition: The accepted swap has exhaustive root-equal before and after component snapshots, exact proposal/capsule/decision/plan bindings, complete BASE TRUE SHAM results, causal receipt issue and expiry times, distinct receipt IDs, distinct raw receipt digests, distinct nonces, and distinct reservation and consumption digests within each envelope.
new_counterexample.expected: Reject because reservation and consumption receipt identities cannot alias across verification and application classes, regardless of which role each class assigns to the repeated identity.
new_counterexample.cause: validateComponentOperationResult compares receipt ID, raw receipt digest, nonce, reservation digest, and consumption digest only against the same field in the other envelope. It never compares either reservation or consumption receipt identity against the opposite role in the other class. The basis, result, and view hashes therefore preserve a role-permuted replay identity instead of rejecting it.
